meta.title: WorkBuddy 400 Fix
meta.description: Fixes WorkBuddy / CodeBuddy "Illegal API invocation from an unapproved channel" (code 11128). With the master switch off, requests go out byte-for-byte unchanged.

title: 11128 fixes
subtitle: Two independent fixes for the domestic and international channels, driven by one master switch

master.label: Master switch
master.hint: When off, requests are sent exactly as-is — not a single byte changed
master.onNow: Master switch on: injection block in place

option.buddyFixHint: Escapes @ at line start or after whitespace into \@. The gateway used to parse @-mentions as file references and answer 11128 when parsing failed.
option.workbuddyFixHint: Adds X-Conversation-ID / Message-ID / Request-ID. The international channel rejects any request missing one of them with 400 request illegal.
option.neutralizeHint: Inserts an invisible separator inside "DeepSeek Harness" — same meaning.
option.demoteSystemHint: Rewrites role=system into role=user with a prefix. Only affects proxies that use the standard fetch.

why.title: What each fix does
why.body: Both channels return the same error code 11128 for completely different reasons, so they are handled per vendor and never interfere.
why.buddyWhy: Domestic (CodeBuddy / copilot.tencent.com): the gateway parses @-mentions in the request body as file references. A long "@ + sentence" fails to parse and is reported as 11128, disguised as a channel block.
why.wbWhy: International (WorkBuddy / www.workbuddy.ai): requires three conversation headers. Missing any one yields request illegal — identical wording to the domestic error, entirely unrelated cause.

status.hookMissingHint: The host half is not running: make sure the plugin is enabled, then restart DSH.
status.meterLinked: Linked with the usage-meter plugin (shared switches)
status.fetchMissingHint: Host half is not running: make sure the plugin is enabled, then restart DSH.
status.gateOff: Master switch off: injection block removed

stats.label: Rewrote {n} requests, escaped {m} @ mentions, added headers {k} times

restore.hint: Switching the master switch off restores the original behaviour: the injection block is removed from OFM and requests go out untouched.
